integrity: The all-size argument is a combinatorial quotient-and-Lefschetz proof conditional on an explicit published sphere theorem. Finite enumeration corroborates rather than certifies generality. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on finite, acyclic, fully essential two-terminal directed multigraphs. Fixed-point spaces are PL homeomorphic to orbit path-complex realizations, not claimed homeomorphic to round spheres. No genuine group-equivariant homotopy equivalence to linear spheres; integral orbit-space homology not classified. The nonequivariant sphere theorem is cited, not new. Equivalent undiscovered earlier work is possible.
title: Fixed-point sphere profiles and integral orientation characters of directed path-avoidance complexes
